definitions.explanation: Marriage between two people of the same sex. A common word in news and debate about marriage law.

examples.japanese: {同性婚|どうせいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
{同性婚|どうせいこん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{同性婚|どうせいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{認|みと}めている→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of countries that recognize same-sex marriage in law grows every year.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同性婚|どうせいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to recognize same-sex marriage
- {同性婚|どうせいこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法制化|ほうせいか}: legalization of same-sex marriage
- {同性婚|どうせいこん}⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧: lawsuits over same-sex marriage

CULTURAL NOTE:
Same-sex marriage is not recognized under Japanese law, and lawsuits seeking it have been a major news topic since 2019. Many local governments, starting with Tokyo's Shibuya and Setagaya wards in 2015, issue partnership certificates (パートナーシップ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧), which do not carry the legal effects of marriage.
